#!/usr/bin/env blender --background --python
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=32, ring_count=16, location=(0, 0, 0))
sphere = bpy.context.object
mat = bpy.data.materials.new('Blue')
mat.diffuse_color = (0.03, 0.25, 0.8, 1)
sphere.data.materials.append(mat)
bpy.ops.object.camera_add(location=(0, -6, 3))
cam = bpy.context.object
cam.rotation_euler = (Vector((0, 0, 0)) - cam.location).to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y').to_euler()
bpy.context.scene.camera = cam
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='AREA', location=(0, -3, 5))
bpy.context.object.data.energy = 500
bpy.context.object.data.shape = 'DISK'
bpy.context.object.data.size = 5
scene = bpy.context.scene
scene.render.engine = 'BLENDER_WORKBENCH'
scene.display.shading.color_type = 'MATERIAL'
scene.render.resolution_x = 640
scene.render.resolution_y = 360
scene.render.resolution_percentage = 100
scene.render.threads_mode = 'FIXED'
scene.render.threads = 8
scene.render.filepath = '/app/final.png'
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath='/app/scene.blend')
bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
